name: smwgraphics-redrawn-styled-boom-boom
title: Redrawn Styled Boom Boom
description:
Custom graphics for everyone's favorite arm flailer/sky swooping miniboss, Iceman & Tsutarja's SMB3 Boom Boom custom sprite, meant to be used alongside Icegoom's redrawn graphics.

Just like the main sprite, it uses SP4 and palette E by default while the Goal/? Sphere uses palette D (a custom one is included in any case).

Give credit if used, as it's always appreciated.
